name: size-reduce and swap lattice basis vectors until nearly orthogonal
mechanism: walk along a lattice basis, subtracting integer multiples of earlier vectors from each vector to keep its projections small, and swap two adjacent vectors whenever the later one is much shorter than the earlier in the orthogonalised sense, repeating until no swap applies

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Lenstra–Lenstra–Lovász algorithm (also known as LLL algorithm)' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms: find a short, nearly orthogonal lattice basis in polynomial time
